subject.title: feat(android): accept audio and document attachments via share sheet and composer

question: Should the curated Android audio/document intake set be accepted as a supported feature once gateway-size behavior, Activity-lifetime handling, and Android runtime proof are complete?
rationale: This is a new user-facing Android capability with a deliberately selected MIME surface; the final supported scope and its upload-size contract need explicit owner confirmation.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded Android feature
options.body: Keep the curated MIME set, fix the two delivery defects, and require device/emulator proof before merging.

options.title: Narrow the feature surface
options.body: Limit the supported types or attachment sizes if the intended gateway contract cannot reliably support the proposed set.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded Android feature
recommendation.body: Keep the curated MIME set, fix the two delivery defects, and require device/emulator proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned contributor for the active Android implementation; broader current-main ownership evidence was unavailable in the supplied material.
